title: Flaky: PRScriptShellTests tests fail with 'Text file busy' race condition on mock gh binary
job_name: Tests / No-package tests (regular, Aspire.Acquisition.Tests, Acquisition, Acquisition, tests/Aspire.Acqui...) / Acquisition (ubuntu-latest)
error_pattern: Aspire.Templates.Tests.ToolCommandException : Expected 0 exit code but got 1: bash get-aspire-cli-pr.sh ... Error: GitHub CLI (gh) command failed: /tmp/aspire-test-.../mock-bin/gh: /bin/bash: bad interpreter: Text file busy
analysis: The test's mock 'gh' binary is invoked while it's still being written to disk, causing an OS-level 'Text file busy' error when bash tries to use it as the interpreter. This is a known race condition in the test's mock binary setup, unrelated to the PR's changes to Aspire.Cli StopCommand and Aspire.Hosting Dcp code.
